title: Service OIDC identity fragment (dormant)
description: Dormant offline copy of the catalog definition.oidc shape. Not referenced by values.schema.json, _identity.tpl, or identity.yaml, which remain normative. Realm fixed to applications; provisioning/issuance/rotation stay with the Keycloak owner (Code + PKCE S256, issuer https://<host>/realms/applications). Confidential clients require secretReference in approval.secretReferences plus a scoped definition.secrets mount; the ExternalSecret reads vault item keycloak-client-secrets. Creates no clients, secrets, or routes.
